description:
The 60th APS, located at Travis Air Force Base (AFB), CA has brand name or equal requirement for a 60 TON Lifting/Spreader Beam to the Caldwell Model 20HS-50-25NS in accordance with Statement of Work (SOW).  (See attached SOW for complete details)

THIS IS A BRAND NAME OR EQUAL REQUIREMENT  

The anticipated North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code for this requirement is 333923 – Overhead Traveling Crane, Hoist and Monorail System Manufacturing.  Product or Service Code (PSC): 2020 Rigging and Rigging Gear

THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY  

This Sources Sought is to determine the availability of businesses to include small businesses (including the following subsets, Small Disadvantaged Businesses, HUBZone Firms; Certified 8(a), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses and Woman Owned Small Business) to provide the required products and/or services.
